shortDefinition.en: A color-rendering adjustment that compensates for illumination to support a chosen neutral or creative appearance.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 补偿照明颜色、服务于预期中性或创意外观的色彩呈现调整。

en: White balance does not change the light that reached the sensor, and one global setting cannot neutralize every mixed-light region.
zh-cn: 白平衡不改变到达传感器的光，一个全局设置也不能让所有混合光区域都中性。

example.en: AWB can be a starting point; a custom measurement can use a white reference under the actual illumination.
example.zh-cn: 可从 AWB 开始，也可用实际照明下的白色参考物测量自定义白平衡。

sources.title: IMAGE QUALITY SETTING (Still Photography) — FUJIFILM X-T5 Owner’s Manual
sources.supports: Automatic, source-specific, and custom white-balance rendering choices.
